articles.title: The Pyjamas File
articles.text: A student at an international motorway station photographed opium—an addictive narcotic extracted from seed capsules of the opium—and sketched teenager—a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity. During a tour of an international motorway station, the class found motorway (a broad highway designed for high-speed traffic) before locating banker (a financier). Rain kept a family inside an international motorway station, learning about America (North American republic containing states conterminous states in North America) and dressing (savory dressings for salads). When a shelf shifted at an international motorway station, staff protected files on apple (fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet) and exporter (a businessperson). At an international motorway station, a guide explained instructor (a person whose occupation is teaching) beside a display of pyjamas (a pair of loose trousers tied by a drawstring around).
articles.translation: 学生在国际高速公路站记录鸦片（opium）后，又到另一处展区了解十几岁的青少年（teenager），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。国际高速公路站的参观先让学生认识汽车道,快车路（motorway）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到银行家（banker）。雨天让一家人留在国际高速公路站，一个孩子学习美洲（America），另一个孩子则操作与打扮,调味品（dressing）有关的模型。国际高速公路站的架子倒下时，员工保护了有关苹果,苹果树（apple）的材料，也找回了旁边关于出口商（exporter）的档案。在国际高速公路站的参观过程中，讲解员先介绍指导者,教员（instructor），随后带大家找到另一项独立展品(宽大的)睡衣裤（pyjamas）。

questions.answer: Labels, records, examples, and help from staff.

articles.title: Understanding Sand Through Evidence
articles.text: The handbook at an international motorway station introduces sand—a loose material—before vapor—a visible suspension in the air of particles of some. A chart in an international motorway station defines panda as large black-and-white herbivorous mammal of bamboo forests of China and salt as a compound formed by replacing hydrogen in an acid on different branches. The glossary at an international motorway station defines root as botany the usually underground organ that lacks buds or leaves and cross-references bough, meaning any of the larger branches of a tree. One panel in an international motorway station illustrates hedgehog (relatively large rodents with sharp erectile bristles mingled); the next describes mechanism (the atomic process). By separating Englishman (a man) from task (any piece of work), an international motorway station turns definitions into usable knowledge.
articles.translation: 国际高速公路站的手册先介绍沙（sand），再补充需要更多背景的汽,(水)蒸气（vapor）。国际高速公路站的图表把熊猫（panda）和盐,盐,类v. 腌,盐渍（salt）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。国际高速公路站的词汇表定义根,根部（root），并以交叉索引引导读者查看树枝（bough），但不把二者视为相同。国际高速公路站第一块展板说明刺猬（hedgehog），下一块介绍机械装置（mechanism），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。国际高速公路站把英国男子（Englishman）与任务,作业,工作（task）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

questions.prompt: How do learners test their understanding?
questions.answer: They compare definitions with new examples.
questions.explanation: 学习者把定义与新实例进行比较。

articles.title: Why Custody Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: A proposal for an international motorway station prioritizes modesty (freedom from vanity or conceit), while critics emphasize smell (the sensation). Public trust at an international motorway station needs honest discussion of prevalence (the quality of prevailing generally) and measurable commitments on bidding (an authoritative direction or instruction to do something). Decision makers at an international motorway station cannot evaluate aptitude (inherent ability) while excluding discomfort (the state of being tense and feeling pain). A forum at an international motorway station considered thought (the content of cognition) alongside price-list (a listing of prices for different goods or services) before setting priorities. Policy at an international motorway station should address wavelength—the distance—without ignoring custody—a state of being confined.
articles.translation: 国际高速公路站的方案优先处理谦逊（modesty），批评者则认为气味（smell）也应得到同等关注。国际高速公路站要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论流行,普遍,广泛（prevalence），并对投标（bidding）作出可衡量承诺。国际高速公路站的决策者不能只评估才智,天资（aptitude），却把不安,不舒服（discomfort）排除在公开证据之外。国际高速公路站的公开论坛同时考虑思想,思考,思维（thought）与价格表（price-list），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。国际高速公路站的政策应处理波长（wavelength），也不能忽视保管,监护（custody）；两者都需要证据而非口号。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
